description.en: Responsive email components compatible with React Email, MJML, and JSX Email.
description.zh: 全面兼容 React Email 与 MJML 的响应式高审美现代 HTML 邮件组件库。

content.en: emailcn brings shadcn's refined component conventions to the notoriously difficult world of HTML email design. Compatible with React Email, MJML, and JSX Email, it offers cross-client verified templates for transactional receipts, newsletters, and security notifications.
content.zh: emailcn 将 shadcn 的现代化设计语言引入了向来排版繁琐的 HTML 邮件世界。全面适配 React Email、MJML 与 JSX Email 编译管道，它提供了在 Gmail、Apple Mail、Outlook 等数十种主流客户端中严格验证过的账单通知、欢迎信与验证码卡片模板。
